title: Spatial count risk with a genuine Laplace GP
description: Infer a smooth relative-risk map and exposure-dependent uncertainty from synthetic Poisson counts.

reproduction.method: Poisson log-Gaussian process, damped Newton posterior mode and inverse-Hessian Laplace covariance
reproduction.description: Infer a smooth relative-risk map and exposure-dependent uncertainty from synthetic Poisson counts.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
A 6×6 artificial geography replaces the Finland heart-attack spatial benchmark.
Dense Matérn-3/2 covariance with fixed hyperparameters replaces sparse FIC, inducing-grid design and covariance hyperparameter MAP optimization.
Risk means and variances are lognormal moments under the actual mode/curvature Gaussian approximation; no MCMC/integrated-Laplace or exact-posterior claims.

metrics.dataset: Synthetic 6 × 6 spatial grid; Poisson counts and population exposures
